0400__L1_Sul_10__E9EF94C9.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0401__L1_Sul_6__A4B9B188.mp3.asr_text: Okay, let's see what we've got. Sound off. Turner.
0401__L1_Sul_6__A4B9B188.mp3.translation: 好，看看都来了谁。点名，答到。特纳！
0401__L1_Sul_6__A4B9B188.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0402__L1_Ma1_2__DC3F9017.mp3.translation: 不错，又来一个模范大兵。
0402__L1_Ma1_2__DC3F9017.mp3.note: 文本审核：AJ squared away 是对规矩、整齐的模范军人的戏称，原译误作完成整理；已修正。

0403__L1_Intro_2__4CF95BE6.mp3.asr_text: We thought we were going to win the war all by ourselves.
0403__L1_Intro_2__4CF95BE6.mp3.translation: 我们本以为靠自己能打赢这场仗。
0403__L1_Intro_2__4CF95BE6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0404__L1_Intro_3__4D077367.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0405__L1_Sul_43__EF386529.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0406__L1_Pol_139__E134F32C.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0407__L1_Sul_140__5AD1B73F.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0408__L1_Sul_141__5ADFCEC0.mp3.asr_text: Damn! Would you look at that? Bet they've been sneaking off the island for days.
0408__L1_Sul_141__5ADFCEC0.mp3.translation: 妈的，你瞧瞧！这帮家伙肯定偷跑了好几天了。
0408__L1_Sul_141__5ADFCEC0.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0409__L1_Ma1_142__9C0F4A14.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0410__L1_Pol_143__E2953EC5.mp3.asr_text: Good riddance if you ask me.
0410__L1_Pol_143__E2953EC5.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0411__L1_Sul_144__5B0A1543.mp3.asr_text: Put your church key away, Polonsky. See every one of them escaping? Well, guess what? We'll be seeing them on the next island.
0411__L1_Sul_144__5B0A1543.mp3.translation: 把你那玩意儿收起来，波隆斯基。看见他们一个个跑了吧？猜怎么着？下个岛还要见。
0411__L1_Sul_144__5B0A1543.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0412__L1_Ma1_145__9C399097.mp3.asr_text: Well, I bet we whoop him for a second time.
0412__L1_Ma1_145__9C399097.mp3.translation: 哼，我赌我们能再揍他一顿。
0412__L1_Ma1_145__9C399097.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0413__L1_Sul_146__5B264445.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0414__L5_SUL_50__76F735C5.mp3.asr_text: Come on, Marines! Let's get up there and give them hell!
0414__L5_SUL_50__76F735C5.mp3.translation: 上啊，弟兄们！冲上去狠狠揍他们！
0414__L5_SUL_50__76F735C5.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0415__L1_Sul_123__57924C84.mp3.asr_text: Stick a charge in that AA, Miller.
0415__L1_Sul_123__57924C84.mp3.translation: 米勒，给那门高射炮装上炸药。
0415__L1_Sul_123__57924C84.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0416__L1_Sul_42__EF2A4DA8.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0417__L1_Sul_34__ED91A40B.mp3.asr_text: Okay, on three, I want you to move through these stables and take out the targets.
0417__L1_Sul_34__ED91A40B.mp3.translation: 好，数到三，你穿过这些马厩，把靶子打掉。
0417__L1_Sul_34__ED91A40B.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0418__L1_Sul_35__ED9FBB8C.mp3.asr_text: One, two, three, go, go, go!
0418__L1_Sul_35__ED9FBB8C.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0419__L1_Sul_60__F277CFE4.mp3.asr_text: Get a move on, Miller! Under the net and through the obstacles! Go! Go!
0419__L1_Sul_60__F277CFE4.mp3.translation: 快点，米勒！钻过网，越过障碍！快！快！
0419__L1_Sul_60__F277CFE4.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0420__L1_Sul_96__F7EAE6C7.mp3.asr_text: Miller, take out the mortar crew!
0420__L1_Sul_96__F7EAE6C7.mp3.translation: 米勒，干掉那个迫击炮组！
0420__L1_Sul_96__F7EAE6C7.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0421__L1_Sul_76__F4813589.mp3.asr_text: Someone get Miller out of that mud!
0421__L1_Sul_76__F4813589.mp3.translation: 谁去把米勒从泥里拉出来！
0421__L1_Sul_76__F4813589.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0422__L1_And_74__7A52A25A.mp3.asr_text: We've got no cover! Use the smoke grenades!
0422__L1_And_74__7A52A25A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0423__L3_SUL_22__AEDABBAA.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0424__L1_Sul_11__E9FDAC4A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0425__L1_Ma1_7__DC86059C.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0426__L1_Pol_3__787B10C8.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0427__L1_Sul_28__EC152970.mp3.asr_text: Remember, anyone can point and shoot, but if you want to zero your rifle like a warrior, you'll want to look straight down the sight and snap in.
0427__L1_Sul_28__EC152970.mp3.translation: 记住，谁都会举枪射击。想像个真正的战士那样瞄准，就要端稳步枪，看准瞄具。
0427__L1_Sul_28__EC152970.mp3.note: 文本审核：snap in 涉及据枪瞄准练习，不能直接译成扣扳机。已修正；zero / snap in 的完整措辞仍需听音及训练动作确认。

0428__L1_Pol_135__E0FC9528.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant, they're dug in just too damn tight there!
0428__L1_Pol_135__E0FC9528.mp3.translation: 中士，他们那儿守得太严了！
0428__L1_Pol_135__E0FC9528.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0429__L1_Sul_138__598D9AA8.mp3.asr_text: Damn right! Now let's finish this!
0429__L1_Sul_138__598D9AA8.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0430__L2_SUL_22__4D4DAC0A.mp3.asr_text: Miller, get on that machine gun and give us some covering fire!
0430__L2_SUL_22__4D4DAC0A.mp3.translation: 米勒，去操纵那挺机枪，掩护我们！
0430__L2_SUL_22__4D4DAC0A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0431__L1_Sul_19__EA6E6852.mp3.asr_text: Miller, I'm talking to you. Over here, son.
0431__L1_Sul_19__EA6E6852.mp3.translation: 米勒，我在跟你说话。过来，孩子。
0431__L1_Sul_19__EA6E6852.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0432__L1_Ma1_0__DC236115.mp3.asr_text: Hey Mac, what's the scuttlebutt on the new honcho?
0432__L1_Ma1_0__DC236115.mp3.translation: 嘿，麦克，新来的头儿有什么说法？
0432__L1_Ma1_0__DC236115.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0433__L1_Pol_1__785EE1C6.mp3.asr_text: I hear the bastard's tough as nails.
0433__L1_Pol_1__785EE1C6.mp3.translation: 听说那家伙是个狠角色。
0433__L1_Pol_1__785EE1C6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0434__L1_Dri_5__1E52E098.mp3.asr_text: You're the new recruit, Sergeant Roebuck.
0434__L1_Dri_5__1E52E098.mp3.translation: 欢迎新加入咱们，罗巴克中士
0434__L1_Dri_5__1E52E098.mp3.note: 待听音：新兵与 Sergeant Roebuck 的身份、断句有疑点；当前 ASR 不足以确定谁是新兵、谁是罗巴克，暂不猜改。

0435__L1_Dri_4__1E44C917.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0436__L1_Sul_8__A4D5E08A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0437__L1_Pol_9__78CF9DCE.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0438__L1_Sul_12__EA0BC3CB.mp3.asr_text: Get over to that table and pick up a rifle, Miller. Double time!
0438__L1_Sul_12__EA0BC3CB.mp3.translation: 去那张桌子拿支步枪，米勒。跑起来！
0438__L1_Sul_12__EA0BC3CB.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0439__L1_Sul_13__EA19DB4C.mp3.asr_text: The rest of you, move out to the rifle range for some dry fire.
0439__L1_Sul_13__EA19DB4C.mp3.translation: 其余的人去靶场练空枪。
0439__L1_Sul_13__EA19DB4C.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0440__L1_Sul_45__EF54942B.mp3.asr_text: Smoke grenades next. You'll use them to conceal your movements on the battlefield and confuse the enemy. Take a few and throw one through the top floor window of that barn.
0440__L1_Sul_45__EF54942B.mp3.translation: 接下来是烟幕弹。用它遮住你的行动，让敌人摸不清。拿几个，往那间谷仓的顶层窗户扔一个。
0440__L1_Sul_45__EF54942B.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0441__L1_Sul_58__F133B34D.mp3.asr_text: Don't think I'm letting you off with forgetting your rifle, Miller. One lap around the hill. I'll be waiting at the end.
0441__L1_Sul_58__F133B34D.mp3.translation: 米勒，忘带枪这事我可不会就这么算了。绕小山跑一圈，我在终点等你。
0441__L1_Sul_58__F133B34D.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0442__L1_Sul_89__F66054AB.mp3.asr_text: Okay, we've got smoke! Go, go, go!
0442__L1_Sul_89__F66054AB.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0443__L1_Pol_97__A18210E5.mp3.asr_text: Hey, Sergeant, I got a tunnel down here.
0443__L1_Pol_97__A18210E5.mp3.translation: 中士，我这下面有个地道。
0443__L1_Pol_97__A18210E5.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0444__L1_Sul_98__F80715C9.mp3.asr_text: Anderson, burn it out. Everyone stay back.
0444__L1_Sul_98__F80715C9.mp3.translation: 安德森，去把它烧了。都退后。
0444__L1_Sul_98__F80715C9.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0445__L1_Sul_36__EDADD30D.mp3.asr_text: What are you waiting for, Miller? An engraved invitation? Get going!
0445__L1_Sul_36__EDADD30D.mp3.translation: 还等什么，米勒？要我下请帖吗？快去！
0445__L1_Sul_36__EDADD30D.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0446__L1_Sul_37__EDBBEA8E.mp3.asr_text: Oh, you really are the best of the best, aren't you, Miller? Get in there!
0446__L1_Sul_37__EDBBEA8E.mp3.translation: 哦，你真是精英中的精英啊，米勒？上啊！
0446__L1_Sul_37__EDBBEA8E.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0447__L14_Pol_43__22D2BBC0.mp3.asr_text: Come on, buddy! We got you covered!
0447__L14_Pol_43__22D2BBC0.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0448__L1_Sul_85__F627F6A7.mp3.asr_text: Polonsky, get some smoke up there! Anderson Miller, when the smoke hits, find cover near the top!
0448__L1_Sul_85__F627F6A7.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，往上面打烟！安德森、米勒，烟一起来就到上面找掩体！
0448__L1_Sul_85__F627F6A7.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0449__L1_Sul_32__ED757509.mp3.asr_text: You think we've got all day, Miller? Pick up your Thompson. Chop, chop. Let's go.
0449__L1_Sul_32__ED757509.mp3.translation: 米勒，你以为我们有一整天？把你的汤普森拿上。快点快点，走。
0449__L1_Sul_32__ED757509.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0450__L1_Sul_33__ED838C8A.mp3.asr_text: Miller! There's a Thompson on the table. Get it now!
0450__L1_Sul_33__ED838C8A.mp3.translation: 米勒！桌上那把汤普森，马上拿！
0450__L1_Sul_33__ED838C8A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0451__L1_Sul_136__59716BA6.mp3.asr_text: Okay, last double A. Get a charge on it, Miller.
0451__L1_Sul_136__59716BA6.mp3.translation: 好，最后一门高射炮。米勒，去装炸药。
0451__L1_Sul_136__59716BA6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0452__L1_Sul_125__57AE7B86.mp3.asr_text: Look at those ships, they're bugging out!
0452__L1_Sul_125__57AE7B86.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0453__L1_Ma1_115__971B06BA.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0454__L1_Sul_116__5607BA68.mp3.asr_text: Damn it, that's one of our birds! He's ditching!
0454__L1_Sul_116__5607BA68.mp3.translation: 糟了，那是我们的飞机！他要在水上迫降了！
0454__L1_Sul_116__5607BA68.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0455__L1_Sul_119__563200EB.mp3.asr_text: I'll tell you right now, until we take out that artillery, we can just forget about air support.
0455__L1_Sul_119__563200EB.mp3.translation: 我直说吧，不把那炮干掉，就别指望空中支援了。
0455__L1_Sul_119__563200EB.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0456__L1_Sul_39__EDD81990.mp3.asr_text: Not too shabby, Miller. We might make you a warrior yet.
0456__L1_Sul_39__EDD81990.mp3.translation: 还行，米勒。说不定能把你练成个好兵。
0456__L1_Sul_39__EDD81990.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0457__L1_Sul_40__EF0E1EA6.mp3.asr_text: Okay, let's see how you handle grenades. Go grab some from the ordinance table over there.
0457__L1_Sul_40__EF0E1EA6.mp3.translation: 好，看看你手榴弹玩得怎么样。去那边桌子拿几个。
0457__L1_Sul_40__EF0E1EA6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0458__L1_Sul_17__EA523950.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Miller. Shoot the helmets off the scarecrows.
0458__L1_Sul_17__EA523950.mp3.translation: 好，米勒。把稻草人上的钢盔打下来。
0458__L1_Sul_17__EA523950.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0459__L1_Sul_44__EF467CAA.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0460__L1_Sul_47__EF70C32D.mp3.asr_text: Okay, that covers grenades. Now follow me to the assault course.
0460__L1_Sul_47__EF70C32D.mp3.translation: 好，手榴弹就到这。跟我去突击训练场。
0460__L1_Sul_47__EF70C32D.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0461__L1_Sul_71__F43AC004.mp3.asr_text: I want suppressing fire on that hill!
0461__L1_Sul_71__F43AC004.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0462__L1_Sul_77__F48F4D0A.mp3.asr_text: Get up, Miller! You're not dead till I say so!
0462__L1_Sul_77__F48F4D0A.mp3.translation: 起来，米勒！我没说你死，你就不许倒下！
0462__L1_Sul_77__F48F4D0A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0463__L1_Sul_72__F448D785.mp3.asr_text: Anderson, I want some flame on that bunker. Get up that hill and get on it!
0463__L1_Sul_72__F448D785.mp3.translation: 安德森，那个碉堡给我烧了。爬上山去，动手！
0463__L1_Sul_72__F448D785.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0464__L1_Sul_73__F456EF06.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0465__L1_Sul_84__F619DF26.mp3.asr_text: Keep moving, Marines! Get up there!
0465__L1_Sul_84__F619DF26.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0466__L1_Ma2_65__1AA8C815.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0467__L1_Sul_100__53FE54C3.mp3.asr_text: Nice work! Anderson, go and check it out!
0467__L1_Sul_100__53FE54C3.mp3.translation: 干得好！安德森，过去看看！
0467__L1_Sul_100__53FE54C3.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0468__L5_MA1_45__35922878.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0469__L1_And_101__8BD24AD1.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0470__L1_Sul_102__541A83C5.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0471__L1_Sul_103__54289B46.mp3.asr_text: Miller, pick up the flamethrower and...
0471__L1_Sul_103__54289B46.mp3.translation: 米勒，去拿上火焰喷射器，然后……
0471__L1_Sul_103__54289B46.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0472__L14_Sul_83__801D0B9F.mp3.asr_text: Get in there, Marines! Go! Go! Go!
0472__L14_Sul_83__801D0B9F.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0473__L1_Sul_147__5B345BC6.mp3.asr_text: Wow! Excellent fruit-killing skills you've got there, Miller. Now stop messing around!
0473__L1_Sul_147__5B345BC6.mp3.translation: 哟，米勒，打水果倒是挺有一手啊。别瞎闹了！
0473__L1_Sul_147__5B345BC6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0474__L1_Sul_23__EBCEB3EB.mp3.asr_text: The targets are over here, soldier.
0474__L1_Sul_23__EBCEB3EB.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0475__L1_Sul_26__EBF8FA6E.mp3.asr_text: Don't get too excited, Marine. Real targets move and fire back at you.
0475__L1_Sul_26__EBF8FA6E.mp3.translation: 别得意，陆战队员。真靶子会动，还会朝你开枪。
0475__L1_Sul_26__EBF8FA6E.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0476__L1_Sul_27__EC0711EF.mp3.asr_text: Not bad. Not bad at all.
0476__L1_Sul_27__EC0711EF.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0477__L1_Sul_148__5B427347.mp3.asr_text: Polanski, take care of that room.
0477__L1_Sul_148__5B427347.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，那间屋交给你。
0477__L1_Sul_148__5B427347.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0478__L1_Pol_149__E2E9CBCB.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0479__L14_Sul_34__77A2E805.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0480__L1_Sul_99__F8152D4A.mp3.asr_text: Miller, get out of the way of the fire!
0480__L1_Sul_99__F8152D4A.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0481__L1_Pol_133__E0E06626.mp3.asr_text: Oh yeah! Now they'll get theirs! But good!
0481__L1_Pol_133__E0E06626.mp3.translation: 太棒了！这下他们完蛋了！
0481__L1_Pol_133__E0E06626.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0482__L13_Sul_9__4F3D2FCF.mp3.asr_text: Let's go, men! Move! Move! Move!
0482__L13_Sul_9__4F3D2FCF.mp3.translation: 走，弟兄们！动起来！动起来！
0482__L13_Sul_9__4F3D2FCF.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0483__L1_Sul_15__EA360A4E.mp3.asr_text: Miller! Get over here and shoot these targets!
0483__L1_Sul_15__EA360A4E.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0484__L1_Sul_20__EBA46D68.mp3.asr_text: Miller, keep this up and I will lock you on but good. Do you read me?
0484__L1_Sul_20__EBA46D68.mp3.translation: 米勒，你再这样，看我怎么收拾你。听明白了吗？
0484__L1_Sul_20__EBA46D68.mp3.note: 文本审核：lock you on 疑有 ASR 错误，不能据此断定关禁闭；已改为不指定处罚方式的训斥，须听音确认。

0485__L1_Sul_21__EBB284E9.mp3.asr_text: Miller! Get over here, that's an order!
0485__L1_Sul_21__EBB284E9.mp3.translation: 米勒！给我过来，这是命令！
0485__L1_Sul_21__EBB284E9.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0486__L1_Sul_18__EA6050D1.mp3.asr_text: Miller, the narrow end with the hole is where the bullet comes out. Now get shooting!
0486__L1_Sul_18__EA6050D1.mp3.translation: 米勒，带孔的那头才是子弹出来的地方。赶紧开枪！
0486__L1_Sul_18__EA6050D1.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0487__L1_Ma1_127__98EC0E5B.mp3.asr_text: I think they've got us pinned down here, Sergeant!
0487__L1_Ma1_127__98EC0E5B.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0488__L1_Sul_124__57A06405.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0489__L1_Ma1_130__9A3E4273.mp3.asr_text: Command says 161st has Shermans inbound to our location.
0489__L1_Ma1_130__9A3E4273.mp3.translation: 指挥部说第161团的谢尔曼坦克正往我们这边来。
0489__L1_Ma1_130__9A3E4273.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0490__L1_Pol_131__E0C43724.mp3.asr_text: Looks like the cavalry's arrived, boys!
0490__L1_Pol_131__E0C43724.mp3.translation: 咱们的救兵到了，弟兄们！
0490__L1_Pol_131__E0C43724.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0491__L1_Ma1_132__9A5A7175.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0492__L1_Sul_122__57843503.mp3.asr_text: They're dug in deep and we gotta get through them to take out that artillery.
0492__L1_Sul_122__57843503.mp3.translation: 他们守得很死，要突破他们的防线才能干掉那些火炮。
0492__L1_Sul_122__57843503.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0493__L1_Sul_114__55EB8B66.mp3.asr_text: This must be Tenaro Village. We need to cut through this mess and take out those AA guns.
0493__L1_Sul_114__55EB8B66.mp3.translation: 这应该就是特纳罗村。得穿过这片乱摊子，把那些高射炮拔掉。
0493__L1_Sul_114__55EB8B66.mp3.note: 待听音：Tenaro 地名拼写可能误识别；须结合语音、任务地名核对，暂保留原译。

0494__L1_Pol_120__DF014704.mp3.asr_text: The Japanese leveled the village. Those sneaky bastards are using the ruins as cover.
0494__L1_Pol_120__DF014704.mp3.translation: 日本人把村子炸平了。这帮鬼子就拿废墟当掩体。
0494__L1_Pol_120__DF014704.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0495__L1_Sul_121__57761D82.mp3.asr_text: They don't give up easy, do they? Keep pushing them back, boys.
0495__L1_Sul_121__57761D82.mp3.translation: 这帮家伙还真顽强。弟兄们，继续把他们往后压。
0495__L1_Sul_121__57761D82.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0496__L1_Sul_41__EF1C3627.mp3.asr_text: See that window on the ground floor? Toss a frag grenade through it!
0496__L1_Sul_41__EF1C3627.mp3.translation: 看见一楼那个窗户没？往里扔颗手雷！
0496__L1_Sul_41__EF1C3627.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0497__L1_Sul_30__ED594607.mp3.asr_text: You're up first, Miller. Pick up a Thompson from the table.
0497__L1_Sul_30__ED594607.mp3.translation: 你先上，米勒。去桌上拿把汤普森。
0497__L1_Sul_30__ED594607.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0498__L1_Sul_29__EC2340F1.mp3.asr_text: All right, Marines, move to the close quarters range. Follow me.
0498__L1_Sul_29__EC2340F1.mp3.translation: 好，弟兄们，去近战靶场。跟我走。
0498__L1_Sul_29__EC2340F1.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0499__L1_Sul_49__EF8CF22F.mp3.asr_text: Okay, time to recap. Some basic combat maneuvers. Just like in TBS. Miller, you will demonstrate.
0499__L1_Sul_49__EF8CF22F.mp3.translation: 好，复习一下基本战术动作。跟训练营里一样。米勒，你来做示范。
0499__L1_Sul_49__EF8CF22F.mp3.note: 待听音：TBS 缩写含义未确认，原译“训练营”不能视为已核实。

0500__L1_Sul_51__F0D10EC6.mp3.asr_text: Don't worry, Miller. I'll be there every step of the way.
0500__L1_Sul_51__F0D10EC6.mp3.translation: 别担心，米勒。我会一路带着你。
0500__L1_Sul_51__F0D10EC6.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0501__L5_SUL_36__73E2118D.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0502__L1_Pol_92__A13B9B60.mp3.translation: 把你们这帮狗东西烤了！
0502__L1_Pol_92__A13B9B60.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0503__L1_Sul_93__F7C0A044.mp3.asr_text: Knock it off, Polonsky. Miller, get over there and clear it out. The rest of you stack up and wait for my signal.
0503__L1_Sul_93__F7C0A044.mp3.translation: 行了，波隆斯基。米勒，你过去清理。其他人列队准备突入，等我信号。
0503__L1_Sul_93__F7C0A044.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0504__L1_Dri_68__AE2A177B.mp3.asr_text: Stop flailing around, will ya? Hey, Fletch, I think this one's drowning. Grab him!
0504__L1_Dri_68__AE2A177B.mp3.translation: 别乱扑腾了行不行？嘿，弗莱奇，我看这家伙要淹死了。抓住他！
0504__L1_Dri_68__AE2A177B.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。

0505__L1_Pol_106__DBEC22CC.mp3.note: 译文已填；ASR 识别未听音校对。
